conclusions: Ordinary opaque panel/slot texture edges exhibit the same single physical X mixed column as both CJK and SGA glyphs. This phenomenon is not specific to the glyph shader.
The slot gray mixed value changes across the nine integer-spaced cells, so a single constant0.08/0.92 weight for every X is not supported.

NearX1260 the slot transition and SGA glyph have overlapping byte-rounding compatible weights near0.93; nearX1332..1404 slot and CJK weights overlap near0.917. These are measured endpoint comparisons, not a fitted global scale.

Every retained known-endpoint horizontal slot probe and the6 tooltip/2 CJK steps are hard Y changes without a mixed row. Excluded probes are reported separately; no conclusion is drawn where the nominal slot colors are occluded.

Evidence is compatible with a common one-dimensional horizontal resampling/subpixel transform factor. It does not distinguish a final UI postpass from per-draw shared projection plus filtering or identify the exact shader/capture mechanism.
excludedProbesAndAreas: Panel outer black-to-world edge is not used for coverage: actual obscured world pixel is unknown.
GUI4 tooltip left corner samples around1262,929 have endpoint variations(198,197,197)/(28,12,27), so they are not treated as an exactly known198/F blend.
No1397px client height or whole-window coordinate transform is inferred.
